fr_scier_verb.hook: "SEE, eh?" Monsieur Verbe SAWS a plank on the trestle and shows the teddy bear on its log stump how it's done: scier (SYAY).
fr_scier_verb.why: C2 follow-up: the painting has no see-saw; the teddy sits on a log watching.

fr_ficelle_noun.hook: TWINE is wound round the neck of a CELLO: fee-SEHL = fi-CELL(o)!
fr_ficelle_noun.why: Crop-edit: tan twine is now painted wound and bow-tied round the neck of the cello, matching the hook.

fr_manivelle_noun.hook: MANY + VEL(vet): a wooden toy man turns the hand CRANK of a winding frame, spooling red VELVET, beside a stack of MANY folded velvet rolls: manivelle [mah-nee-VEHL].
fr_manivelle_noun.why: Pack C v2 (approved, 3b54c783): wooden toy man cranks red velvet onto a spool beside a stack of velvet rolls; text from SESSION_OCT29 item C.

fr_reparation_noun.hook: A little blue robot tightens the wheel nut to REPAIR a bicycle wheel. Réparation [ray-pah-rah-SYOHN] means repair; this is a meaning picture, not a full sound pun.
fr_reparation_noun.why: C2 follow-up: the robot repairs a lone bicycle wheel.
